allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 5 InterfaceAlias, NextHop, RouteMetric, ifIndex" 2>&1)
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-NetAdapter Wi-Fi | Select-Object Status, LinkSpeed; Get-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceAlias Wi-Fi" 2>&1)

Bash(powershell -Command "Get-NetFirewallRule | Where-Object {$_.Direction -eq 'Outbound' -and $_.Action -eq 'Block' -and $_.Enabled -eq 'True'} | Select-Object DisplayName, Action, Direction, Enabled | Format-Table -AutoSize" 2>&1)
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-NetFirewallRule -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Enabled True | Select-Object DisplayName | Format-Table -AutoSize" 2>&1)

Bash(powershell -Command "Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceAlias Wi-Fi -ServerAddresses 8.8.8.8, 8.8.4.4; Set-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress 8.8.8.8 -DohTemplate https://dns.google/dns-query -AllowFallbackToUdp $false -AutoUpgrade $true; Set-DnsClientDohServerAddress -ServerAddress 8.8.4.4 -DohTemplate https://dns.google/dns-query -AllowFallbackToUdp $false -AutoUpgrade $true" 2>&1)
